ZDELRANGE.summary: Deletes every key in a range from the ZMap ordered key-value store.
ZDELRANGE.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of keys in the range.

arguments.name: begin
arguments.summary: The start of the range, inclusive. Use * for an unbounded start.

arguments.name: end
arguments.summary: The end of the range, exclusive. Use * for an unbounded end.
